title: Ada and the Echo
author: Z. M. Quintana
blurb: Ansel Ashgrove, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
